description: The effect pictures a map loads into video memory when it is entered. textures: in load order; name is the id maps use, file the picture on the disc, image the shared picture place it goes to (effects, fire, blood), v and palette_row move it inside that place (absent: where the place was left). boot: the blood sheet loaded once at start. maps: per map name, the texture names it loads, or {texture, unless_flag} to skip one once a story flag (flags.json name) is set. Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
